entries.reason: Upstream reports all published picomatch versions through latest 4.0.7 affected, with no first patched version as of 2026-11-17. Frontend uses it transitively for repository-controlled build, lint and test glob patterns; application source does not import it, and the production nginx image copies only compiled assets, not Node tooling. This is temporary risk acceptance, not a vulnerability fix: keep untrusted glob patterns out of tooling, track the advisory, and upgrade/remove this entry when a patched release is available.

Development-only transitive dependency of @opengsd/gsd-pi (devDependency, never shipped or deployed); extract-zip 2.0.1 is the latest upstream release with no patched version for either symlink-traversal advisory. Re-evaluate when upstream releases a fix or before this expiry.
